change_reason: Recording formula and simulation behavior resolved before primary response estimation
model: weighted least squares: category one-hot coefficients plus session fixed nuisance effects; separate fits by population and metric
recording_term_decision: physical recordings are nested within category in every metric/population and cannot enter as additional fixed effects; equal recording weights and whole-animal bootstrap carry recording structure
weighting: equal categories; equal animals within category; equal recordings within category/animal; equal cells within category/animal/recording
effect: population variance with K denominator of fitted named-category coefficients; session nuisance set to zero for standardization
normalization: 100 times dispersion divided by weighted raw-cell outcome variance in the same draw/population
timescale_point: average ten separately fitted complete effects, including nonlinear dispersion and normalization
timescale_bootstrap: resample animals with nested sessions; select one of ten matched draws independently for each sampled MouseV2 session occurrence; apply five-cell floor per selected draw
interval: 95% percentile interval from 5000 paired whole-animal bootstrap replicates
simulation: observed design with synthetic session shifts, recording shifts, and cell noise; targeted TTFS V1 follow-up retained because small-run coverage was low
rf_cross_population: unsupported for every metric under config/figure4_rerun_v2.json; no adjusted cross-population null estimate will be generated
rf_hva_only: supported for all metrics; hierarchy adjustment is a separate later result
